rationale: Correct the existing company to the bounded 24-facility Cleveland Clinic sale-leaseback portfolio. Direct manager and title evidence supports Fengate and MedCraft Healthcare Real Estate as current joint owners at undisclosed stakes, Cleveland Clinic as former fee owner and continuing tenant/operator, and a September 2025 closed transaction. The separate Fengate-Montecito Project Lotus portfolio is not merged.

companyFieldUpdates.description: Fengate-MedCraft Cleveland Clinic Outpatient Portfolio is a 24-facility medical-outpatient sale-leaseback portfolio across Ohio and Florida totaling more than 900,000 square feet. Fengate Asset Management and MedCraft Healthcare Real Estate acquired the portfolio in September 2025 through FG MC II Cleveland, LLC and location-specific title entities; public sources do not disclose their percentages or a deal-specific Fengate fund. Cleveland Clinic and title affiliates were the former fee owners and remain the principal tenant/operator under long-term leases. The portfolio is the first Fengate-MedCraft joint-venture acquisition and is distinct from Fengate's separate Project Lotus investment with Montecito. No later disposal, recapitalization, owner exit or signed ownership transaction was identified through August 29, 2026.
